text:
rahul: Hey team — during onboarding we're seeing a big spike of 429s when we ramp to ~50 concurrent init calls. SDK v1.3.2 in browser. Flow is ephemeral token per client, rotating every 60s. Getting 401s then a cascade of 429s. Demo is tomorrow, any quick mitigations? :grimacing:
amanda: hey @rahul — sorry you're blocked. quick q: are you creating a new ephemeral token for every tab/request, or reusing tokens for short windows? which region are you hitting? can you paste sanitized headers?
rahul: ephemeral per user session, rotation 60s, region us-west-2. headers (sanitized): Authorization: Bearer <omitted>, x-client-id: repo-123. We see many simultaneous /v1/preflight requests at init.
kevin: that rotation freq is a classic thundering herd on the preflight/auth path. if tokens rotate <2m you want to splay refreshes + allow a short reuse window. also cap preflight fanout in the client (per-host concurrency).
amanda: short-term mitigation: add jitter to refresh, temporarily increase TTL to 3m for the demo, and set the SDK preflight splay. example (node): ```js const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.RW_KEY, preflightSplayMs: 2000 }) ``` try setting REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_SPLAY=2000 locally.
sasha: also make sure your retry/backoff honors Retry-After. recommend exponential backoff with jitter, initial 250ms. if you can share a HAR showing simultaneous /v1/preflight calls we can validate pattern.
rahul: quick test — increased TTL to 3m and added 500–1500ms jitter. 429s dropped by ~80%, but still seeing occasional 401s right when rotation occurs. attaching relevant log snippet: `POST /v1/preflight 401 -> refresh token -> POST /v1/preflight 429` (happens in a tight window).
amanda: for the 401-on-rotate, either have the auth service accept the previous token for a short grace window (10s) or have the client treat 401 as retryable: `if (res.status === 401) { await refresh(); return retry(); }`. adding a 5–10s grace on the server is the least invasive.
tyler: another angle — HTTP/2 connection limits at the edge plus many short-lived preflight conns can cause sequential failures. if you see connection errors in the browser, try keepalive or route some traffic via another edge/reg to spread connections.
rahul: implementing jitter + grace window now. will run load test and report back. if after mitigation >5% 429s remain we'll open a ticket. thanks everyone, huge help :rocket:
amanda: great — i'll monitor this thread and tag support if needed. assigning follow-up: amanda to watch until Friday demo.
support-bot: Reminder: please create a support ticket if error rate remains >5% after mitigations. Use template: CS-ONBOARD-<client>-<short-desc>.
rahul: will do, thanks all!
